diglot.guessPrompt: What does this word mean? Have a guess first, then look.
diglot.settingsHint: Some words in the chat are replaced with the language you are learning
diglot.llmRefineHint: Lets the AI pick the word that fits the sentence. More accurate, and it costs a little on each message.
diglot.learningWordsEmpty: Once you start chatting, the words you pick up appear here.
diglot.pairDownloadFailed: The download did not finish. You can pick it again to retry; your current language is untouched.
diglot.placementHint: Thirty words, about two minutes. Afterwards new words start from where you already are, instead of from the very beginning. You can skip it.

door.guessPrompt: Have a guess first: what is it, in one sentence?
door.expandPrefill: About "{{label}}", I would like to go deeper:

focus.askPlaceholder: Ask about what you are reading…
focus.mapHint: Tap a stop to jump there. Solid lines grew from a word you picked; dashed ones grew from a question.
focus.errorPlain: This stop did not come out. You can try again, or leave focus.
focus.errorWithReason: This stop did not come out: {{reason}}. You can try again, or leave focus.
focus.errorNoApi: This stop did not come out: no AI service is set up yet. Add one in settings, then try again.

teach.sectionHint: Explain something you have learned to a beginner. Explaining it once usually sticks better than reading it again.
teach.opener: I am learning "{{topic}}" and have not really got it yet. Could you explain it in your own words? Starting from what it is would be great.
